previous_statement: Apply lem-compcb-rectangular-product at square amplification level n to the compatible pair (A_0,B). For e at the common threshold fixed in node 1.1, it gives ||A_0 dot B-A_0B|| <= C e ||A_0|| ||B|| = C e r^2. Substituting the norm identity from the preceding block computation yields ||h u_Q-X^dagger X|| <= C e r^2. Thus the notation (X^dagger,X) in node 1.3.2 is rigorously realized by their canonical zero-padded square representatives (A_0,B), not by feeding nonsquare matrices to the theorem.
new_statement: The proposed square-zero-padding application is unavailable under this shard's exact allowed inputs. Node 1.3.2.1 yields only B in M_n tensor S_{P,Q} and A_0 in M_n tensor S_{Q,P}, not the memberships B in S_{P_n,Q_n} and A_0 in S_{Q_n,P_n} required for a compatible amplified rectangular pair; node 1.3.2.2 cannot supply those missing memberships. Therefore lem-compcb-rectangular-product cannot be instantiated with (A_0,B), and neither ||A_0 dot B-A_0B|| <= C e r^2 nor ||h u_Q-X^dagger X|| <= C e r^2 is established here. A valid proof of node 1.3.2 requires registry-level provisioning of the missing amplification/corner and norm-identification inputs; absent those inputs, node 1.3.2 is blocked.
